name: Dave — lots of flights, narrow experience
summary: Coastal soaring pilot. 120 short flights but only 22 hours, out most weeks, superb ground handling and launches, wing feels sluggish in light sea breeze. Has never been in a thermal and says reading rough air 'hasn't really come up'.
why_this_persona: Tests the hours-versus-flights split (disagreements point 2) and the handling of unevidenced checks. His hands are better than most Ready pilots', but one gate-level check is simply untested, so the result defaults down rather than up.

notes: His result must not read as a telling-off: his flying is strong and the only thing missing is exposure he hasn't chosen to seek out yet.
Owner decision flagged in the summary: whether a pilot like Dave should be able to reach Ready. Current rubric says no, on the conservative default.
